title: AWX Projects, Templates, Credentials, and RBAC
objective: Model governed shared automation in AWX or Automation Controller.

sourceAlignment.title: Ansible for DevOps, 2nd Edition
sourceAlignment.author: Jeff Geerling
sourceAlignment.note: Original Code Forge companion material; no book prose is reproduced.

paragraphs: Projects synchronize version-controlled content. Inventories define targets, credentials are injected securely, and job templates bind those pieces to a playbook and launch policy.
Schedules, workflows, surveys, notifications, APIs, logs, and RBAC turn command-line automation into an auditable service. Teams should receive only the permissions they need.
explanation.rule: Operational rule: Model governed shared automation in AWX or Automation Controller.
